Subject: Clarification on RFQ - Corrugated Boxes FY2026-27 Annual Rate Contract

Dear Western India Cartons Team,

Thank you for your submission in response to our RFQ for the corrugated boxes FY2026-27 annual rate contract.

Please clarify the following points:

1. For your raw-material (kraft paper) linked pricing, what is the validity period of the rates, the index used, and the price-change formula?
2. For line 10, what is the confirmed quantity you can commit to supply given that your stated capacity is below our annual requirement?
3. As you have quoted GST at 12%, what is the confirmed GST rate applicable to corrugated boxes that you will charge?

We look forward to your response.

Regards,
Category Buyer, Sahyadri Consumer Products Ltd, Chakan MIDC, Pune
